name: Xindeng Shouye
source:
An Illuminator from Lightfall Beacon, currently responsible for navigation on the sea, in other words, she drives boats. She seems to dislike the land and displays a timid side upon returning to it.

[spoiler]Before becoming a navigator on the sea, she used to work in a mine near Starshard Beacon, responsible for the guiding work as well. Witnessing various tragic events in the mine left her with psychological trauma, but she never shirks her responsibilities as an Arboranger.[/spoiler]
